app.title: Show HN: Whiteboard (YC W26) – An open-source IDE for thoughtful software design
app.author: sidharthkmenon
app.description: A lightweight, open‑source IDE focused on visual design and architecture diagrams.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `npm install`
Execute `npm run start` and verify the web interface loads
Open a new diagram file, add a component, save, and confirm the file format
Run the CLI command `whiteboard --help` and check output
Measure startup time and compare to 5 seconds
